page.overview:
Who is Uraga?

While not much is known about Uraga's appearance prior to his encounter with Ubume, his brutalized appearance is described as consisting of a crushed windpipe and an emaciated arm that was "as skinny as a twig". He also had blood-soaked bandages.

Sanemi described him as "strong and hearty"; he was shown to be someone who valued his girlfriend, as he showed concern for her even when heavily injured. Sanemi also remembered him stating a desire to start a family. However, Uraga was shown to have become fatalistic in his final moments, as when Ubume caused him to spasm, he believed escaping was hopeless and committed suicide.

Uraga did not get along with his parents, particularly his mother. At some point, Uraga entered and passed the same Final Selection as Sanemi Shinazugawa, leaving a decent impression on the young Demon Slayer who viewed him as strong and hearty, and opening up about his desire to start a family.

Later on, Uraga and another Demon Slayer were kidnapped by Ubume, the Lower Rank One of the Twelve Kizuki. They were brutalized and tortured by Ubume, so the demon could twistedly nurse them back to health. While his partner did not survive, Uraga barely clung to life. Sanemi encountered the heavily injured Uraga and his dead partner while he faced an illusion from Ubume's Blood Demon Art. Uraga vomited, causing Ubume to clean him and attempt to give the Demon Slayer water from a pitcher, although he was too weak to swallow. As Sanemi approached the demon, Uraga called for help, leading Sanemi to recognize him. Ubume became vexed and attempted to claw at Uraga's throat, but the Demon Slayer was saved by Sanemi.
